profile.headline: Independent Software Developer / Founder | Certified Personal Trainer
profile.summary:
As an independent software developer with 1.5+ years of experience, I specialize in architecting and deploying full-stack applications, advanced algorithmic data structures, and automated systems using Python. My recent work includes the development of a subscription-based sports analytics platform, leveraging Clerk authentication and Cloudflare DNS routing, as well as automated social media orchestrators to enhance brand strategies.  

My expertise in performance improvement, biology, and sports nutrition complements my role as a Certified Personal Fitness Trainer (CPFT) and Certified Sports & Fitness Nutrition Specialist (CSFNS) with 3+ years of experience. At Echelon Sports Performance, I focus on bio-optimization management by analyzing internal biomarkers to enhance recovery and energy. Passionate about health and technology, I aim to create innovative solutions that drive holistic performance improvements.

positions.title: Independent Software Developer / Founder
positions.description:
• Architected and deployed full-stack applications and custom web scrapers using Python on Replit.  
• Developed a subscription-based sports analytics platform with Clerk authentication and Cloudflare DNS routing.  
• Engineered algorithmic data structures to calculate Expected Value (EV) Edge metrics for enhanced analytics.  
• Built automated social media orchestrators to manage brand content strategies and scale audience outreach.

positions.title: Certified Personal Trainer
positions.description: As a dedicated personal trainer, my expertise lies in sculpting physiques and enhancing athletic prowess through tailored strength training programs. Nutrition isn’t just a side note; it’s a cornerstone of my philosophy, ensuring that your body receives the fuel it needs to surpass boundaries. With the convenience of online coaching, your location is no barrier to achieving your fitness goals. My background isn’t just theoretical; it’s forged in the competitive fires of collegiate and professional sports arenas, where I’ve honed my skills and developed a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed. This isn’t just a job for me; it’s a lifelong hobby that has blossomed into a fervent passion. Let’s embark on this transformative journey together, where every lift, sprint, and meal propels you closer to your zenith.

positions.title: Fitness Manager
positions.description:
Work-Study

Provide great customer service to the community; see that all customers, clients, and members are given prompt and courteous service.

Maintain cleanliness of gymnasium by policing the area for trash and unattended items.

Demonstrate an understanding of the rules and fundamentals of indoor sports such as basketball, volleyball, indoor soccer and other programs offered in the gymnasium.

Verify membership through the POS system.

Maintain accurate equipment check out and check-in system.

Provide information and answer questions about available programs.

Report all equipment and gymnasium problems to the Center Director.

Enforcing all rules that pertain to the gymnasium on a constant basis.

Adhere to ECCC operations as well as all policy procedures as adopted by Administration.

Observe all safety rules and regulations.
